# Municipal Ordinance No. 09, Series of 2024

**An Ordinance Authorizing the Local Chief Executive to Initiate Expropriation Proceedings Over the 395 Square Meters of Land Covered by TCT No. T-16138 in the Name of Ramon Faustino B. Urlanda**

## Summary

This ordinance authorizes the [[Municipal Mayor]] of [[Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province]] to initiate expropriation proceedings (eminent domain) over a 395-square-meter parcel of land covered by Transfer Certificate of Title (TCT) No. T-16138, registered in the name of [[Ramon Faustino B. Urlanda]]. The ordinance was adopted during an online session and was reviewed and declared **valid** by the [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] under SP Resolution No. 2024-0910.

## Key Provisions

- Authorizes the Local Chief Executive to initiate expropriation proceedings
- Identifies the subject property: 395 square meters covered by TCT No. T-16138
- Names the registered owner: Ramon Faustino B. Urlanda
- Invokes the municipality's power of eminent domain under Section 19 of RA 7160
- Declares the public purpose for the expropriation

## Provincial Review

The [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] of [[Quezon Province]] reviewed this ordinance under **SP Resolution No. 2024-0910** dated October 7, 2024 (conducted via online session), and declared it **VALID**. The exercise of eminent domain by the municipality was found to comply with the requirements of Section 19 of RA 7160.

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan ng Pitogo]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Quezon Province]]
- [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]]
- [[Ramon Faustino B. Urlanda]] — Registered owner of subject property
- [[Dexter S. Sayat]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Paul Timothy C. Villaflor]] — Municipal Vice Mayor
